## Synthesis Overview

PR #255 is a narrowly scoped configuration fix that propagates `"echo*": "allow"` and `"chroma/*": true` into the six model-specific agent variant files that were missing them (three auditor variants, three researcher variants), bringing them into parity with their parent definitions. All three models agree unconditionally that the changes are correct, complete, and ready to merge — no critical or warning findings were identified by any reviewer. Claude went deeper into pre-existing style and documentation issues not introduced by this PR; GPT and Gemini found nothing beyond confirming the fix is sound. The highest-confidence outcome is a clean merge with two minor pre-existing follow-up items worth tracking.

**Model Agreement Score:** 9/10

### ★☆☆ Singular Findings (Only One Model Reported)

```
[S-I-01] Tool ordering in auditor variants diverges from parent auditor.md
Severity: Suggestion
Category: Style
File: .opencode/agents/auditor-kimi.md, auditor-qwen.md, auditor-glm.md
Lines: tools: block (approximately lines 28–30 in variants)
Detail: The parent auditor.md declares tools in order: chroma/*, context7/*, tavily/* (lines 32–34).
All three auditor variants after this PR declare them: chroma/*, tavily/*, context7/*. YAML maps
are semantically unordered and runtime behaviour is identical, but the visual divergence makes
future lockstep sync reviews harder to validate at a glance.
Model: Claude
Assessment: Verified genuine via grep of auditor.md (chroma→context7→tavily) and auditor-kimi.md
(chroma→tavily→context7). Runtime impact is nil. Genuine style finding, not introduced by this PR
(the variants already had tavily/context7 before this change added chroma/*). Worth a follow-up
tidy but not a blocker.
Suggestion: Reorder variants to match parent (chroma/*, context7/*, tavily/*), or standardise
the parent to match the variants. Either direction is acceptable.
```

```
[S-I-02] opencode-runtime.md line 197: "researcher family has the only developer-local MCP
dependency" — inaccurate since auditor variants also carry Tavily and Context7
Severity: Suggestion
Category: Documentation
File: docs/features/opencode-runtime.md
Lines: 197
Detail: Line 197 reads: "The researcher family still has the only developer-local MCP dependency
in the agent inventory." However, auditor-kimi.md, auditor-qwen.md, and auditor-glm.md all
declare io.github.tavily-ai/tavily-mcp/* and io.github.upstash/context7/* — the same
developer-local tools. The inaccuracy predates this PR and was not introduced by these changes.
Model: Claude
Assessment: Verified genuine via grep. The sentence is factually incorrect as of the auditor
variants receiving those tools in an earlier commit. Pre-existing documentation drift; worth a
targeted fix in a follow-up.
Suggestion: Update line 197 to acknowledge that both researcher and auditor families carry
developer-local MCP dependencies (Tavily, Context7).
```

